I honestly can’t express how much I love TLOU. It’s easily one of my all time favorite games, and I’m so happy to finally have it in my Steam collection!

Well this review is pretty simple to write everyone knows the game and i just need to share my experience of how the game actually runs; after the patches and bug fixes game runs pretty much flawlessly except for the shader buildings which takes about an hour to get finished oh and keep in mind that everytime there is a big update or if you update your graphics driver the shaders have to be compiled again i got a 1660ti and i can run it on medium no problem 75+ fps i even got to tweak it to high on some graphics option plus the FSR2.0 and i got 60+ fps and gorgeous graphics. as for the dlc (deluxe version) keep in mind that the only thing that actually worth something is there "Left Behind" dlc and everything else is pretty much worthless but as for the pricing if you wait for another month or two maybe it'll get a 30% discount but the game is already fairly priced imo.

Note: if you have 16GB of ram make sure you close apps that use your ram (like Chrome etc) cause the game will crash as soon as you run out of ram for it and it runs out fast.

I don't play many of them and generally don't enjoy combat-heavy games, but this game may be the one that changes all of that. I cannot recommend The Last of Us enough. I played this in the most easy mode possible, and even though I struggled at first, it felt very doable. You'll be fine if you aren’t used to these types of games like I am. For me, the story is the star of the show; the writers did a beautiful job. I was entirely immersed in the world and the characters' stories. There is so much depth in everything, from the environment to the little notes left by those who have passed to the design of each character. I hate fighting, but to still go through probably 15 hours of combat (I had to replay the bloater fights soooo many times) and never get bored is a true feat. I have no complaints; I love this game.

First and foremost:
If you have horizontal lines, try the following, it worked for me:
1. Keep VSYNC: ON
2. Go to your NVIDIA control panel or AMD equivalent and turn OFF Gysync/freesync for this game (or globally)
3. (OPTIONAL - if still doing it) Keep anti aliasing and Upscaling on Default.

I hope this helps someone else.

Now with that said, this game is great, it is handsdown one of the greatest single player games of all time in my books. The only sad thing is the port, as a number of people have had issues with it. Now I didnt have any problems running the game at all but that could be due to fixes. This is the sad part though as one of the issues I see the most about is still the horizontal lines and the fact that this is still an issue is crazy.

I remember the aiming in the original back in the day being hard but something about this version of the game makes it feel clunky.

I cant vote this down though because I still get to play it and that makes me happy, its been over 10 years since I played the original and its sad that this will be the last Sony game I ever buy.
